description: Correct the agro update download source in the docs and guard the retired OH_JS_URL.

userStories.title: State the agro update download source and guard the retired variable
userStories.description: As a reader of the docs site, I want the `agro update` row to name the real override and default so that my override works.
acceptanceCriteria: Before the docs change, `pnpm run check:docs-drift` exits 1 and names `OH_JS_URL` in `docs/lifecycle-commands.md`. The evidence records the command and the exit status.
`docs/lifecycle-commands.md` row `get-agro.sh` names `AGRO_JS_URL` only and the default `https://github.com/mifunedev/agro/releases/latest/download/agro.js`.
`scripts/check-docs-drift.mjs` `RETIRED` has one entry that matches `OH_JS_URL`, with an `instead` text that names `AGRO_JS_URL`.
`scripts/check-docs-drift.test.mjs` asserts that the entry matches `OH_JS_URL` and does not match `AGRO_JS_URL`.
After the docs change, `pnpm run check:docs-drift`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm run typecheck`, and `pnpm run build` exit 0.
userStories.notes: Accepted by the advisor on the integrated task branch at 4588ac7. AC1 executed: the advisor ran the final scripts/check-docs-drift.mjs against a git archive of main at bb9b6cf -> exit 1, OH_JS_URL named at docs/lifecycle-commands.md:106. AC2 executed: the row reads "downloads `AGRO_JS_URL` (default `https://github.com/mifunedev/agro/releases/latest/download/agro.js`)"; grep -rn OH_JS_URL docs -> exit 1; the worker checked the default against harness self-upgrade.ts:67 and the OH_JS_URL behavior against self-upgrade.test.ts:444. AC3 executed: RETIRED gains one entry /\bOH_JS_URL\b/g whose instead names AGRO_JS_URL. AC4 executed: pnpm test -> exit 0 with match and no-match tests. AC5 executed: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then check:docs-drift, test, typecheck, build -> exit 0 each.
